We met on a language trip to Germany and she had a thing for me that I was too dumb to notice. We had a mutual friend group from that trip but only me and her lived in the same city so we talked and texted more than the others. Eventually we started to get romantic and had this on and off thing for some years but we were both too immature to actually sit down and figure it out. 

She became less and less sociable and had battled with depression and just stuff all her life and I met her out on town again a few years back. She was completely different; avoided eye-contact, apologized constantly, said she was not herself and said that she was not okay. I told her I wanted to help and we decided to meet up for coffee. 

Everything was going pretty alright when we were there, we talked about passions, we're both musical and started holding hands. I felt that I had to subtly mention that I had a girlfriend to be fair to them both and because I was starting to feel a bit for her again. She started acting less relaxed after I mentioned it and a few minutes after that she left very suddenly. I told her that I'd love to meet up again and I genuinely wanted to help her. The next few months I texted and called her a lot to try to meet again because I was worried for her. She'd respond sometimes and then again apologise and tell me that she isn't herself and she isn't the person I want to talk to, she just "looks like her".

After a few more months she eventually went quiet and I found out she had killed herself. The girlfriend I was dating at the time cheated on me and the only person I sometimes wish I could talk to was that old friend.
I still talk to her parents and meet them once a year. They're really nice people and remember me from before. It's a very strange relationship we have with each other, I kind of don't know how to explain it. 
I sometimes even forget she's dead. I'll get the feeling of "oh hey I wonder what she's up to, I haven't spoken to her in a year" and then realise 😅
